description: Swap 20000 on A (collect 199, earn 99) and 20000 on B (collect 199, earn 99), then claim 99 on pool A three times. The seeded hook checks each request against lifetime entitlement (99) instead of remaining entitlement, so all three succeed and pay 297 total: 297 > 99 earned demonstrates R2, and 297 > 199 collected on A demonstrates R3 because the third payment is backed by pool B's reserve (custody 398 -> 101, below B's 199). The repaired control pays 99 once and rejects the two repeats with no violation.
